nodes.description: msg.sender - caller controlled address used across transfer, approve, delegate, distribute and list.
tx.origin - used to set owner and to seed allowance in the ROBOSHIB constructor.
block.timestamp - used to build the Uniswap deadline block.timestamp + 600.
BotProtected.owner / ROBOSHIB.owner - privileged address gating delegate, distribute and list.
BotProtected.botProtection - external contract invoked via low-level call in checkBots, distribute and list.
BotProtected.uniPair - pair address passed into the external bot protection call and granted allowance.
ROBOSHIB.balanceOf mapping - token balances mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and list.
ROBOSHIB.allowance mapping - spender allowances, decremented with unchecked arithmetic and self-approved to router.
ROBOSHIB.totalSupply - fixed supply used in the arithmetic expression totalSupply * 6 / 100.
ROBOSHIB.pancakeRouter - IUniswapV2Router02 instance used for addLiquidityETH liquidity call.
ROBOSHIB.wrappedEther - WETH address used to derive the pair in the constructor.
BotProtected.checkBots modifier - performs an arbitrary low-level call to botProtection before executing the modified body.
ROBOSHIB constructor - sets owner from tx.origin, derives uniPair and seeds allowances.
ROBOSHIB.transfer - external payable entry that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
ROBOSHIB.transferFrom - guarded by checkBots, uses unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
ROBOSHIB.approve - writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
ROBOSHIB.delegate - owner-only arbitrary delegatecall execution into an attacker supplied address.
ROBOSHIB.pairForPancake - pure helper computing the pair address via CREATE2 keccak hash.
ROBOSHIB.distribute - owner-only mass balance assignment plus an external low-level bot protection call.
ROBOSHIB.list - owner-only liquidity listing that sets balances, calls the router and mints to a list.
a.delegatecall(b) - executes arbitrary bytecode in the storage context of the token.
botProtection.call(...15274141...) - unchecked low-level external call executed before state mutation.
botProtection.call(...d5eaf4c3...) - unchecked low-level external call inside distribute.
botProtection.call(...d5eaf4c3...) - unchecked low-level external call inside list before the distribution loop.
pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) - external router call forwarding ETH.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value - unchecked subtraction on balances.
balanceOf[_to] += _value - unchecked addition on balances.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 - unchecked multiplication/division when assigning owner balance.
block.timestamp + 600 - timestamp derived swap deadline passed to the router.

edges.reason: tx.origin is assigned to owner, letting the transaction origin become the privileged owner.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1), seeding an unlimited allowance from the transaction origin.
msg.sender is the implicit caller checked against _from inside transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner).
distribute gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner).
list gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner).
block.timestamp feeds the deadline arithmetic.
the timestamp derived deadline is passed to the router call inside list.
totalSupply is multiplied by 6 and divided by 100 without SafeMath.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
list assigns balanceOf[msg.sender] using totalSupply * 6 / 100.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
the constructor computes uniPair through pairForPancake.
distribute uses loop counter i to iterate over the address array.
list uses loop counter i to iterate over the recipient arrays.
the checkBots modifier performs an external call before transferFrom mutates balances and allowances.
checkBots makes a low-level call to botProtection before the guarded function body executes.
distribute makes an unchecked low-level call to botProtection between state mutations.
list calls botProtection via low-level call before running the balance distribution loop.
list forwards ETH to the external pancakeRouter via addLiquidityETH.
delegate forwards attacker supplied calldata to an arbitrary address via delegatecall, executing in this contract's storage context.
_to is the recipient parameter consumed by transfer.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transfer.
_from is the debited source parameter of transferFrom.
_to is the credited destination parameter of transferFrom.
_value flows into the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
a is the arbitrary delegatecall target supplied to delegate.
b is the arbitrary delegatecall payload supplied to delegate.
_reallyGoHere provides the recipient addresses for distribute.
amount is written into every recipient balance by distribute.
_numList configures the token amount reserved and added as liquidity in list.
_amounts supplies the per-recipient balances assigned in list.

normalization_plan.reason: _to parameter is only meaningful as an argument of ROBOSHIB.transfer.
_value parameter is only meaningful as an argument of ROBOSHIB.transfer.
_from parameter belongs to the transferFrom dataflow.
_to parameter belongs to the transferFrom dataflow.
_value parameter feeds the unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom.
delegatecall target a is only used by ROBOSHIB.delegate.
delegatecall payload b is only used by ROBOSHIB.delegate.
_reallyGoHere array is only consumed by distribute.
amount is only consumed by distribute.
_amounts array is only consumed by list.
loop counter i is local to distribute.
loop counter i is local to list.
